messages.text: Hi Jess! I’m a 22-year-old student working part-time as a Barista in West End. I am looking for a long term rental with like-minded people who enjoy outdoor pursuits, can chat over a drink or board game, yet also appreciate their own space. I have experience with share-houses, so i am very mindful of sharehouse etiquette. I am clean and respectful (and I also like to contribute on occasion with my baking 🧁). My hobbies include rock climbing, baking, scouting op shops, painting, and watching live music. I would love to be considered for this spot! Please let me know if you’d like further information. ✨
